title: carex filipes var. tremula
intro: Carex filipes var. tremula, commonly known as Quaking Grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). The plant is known for its striking yellow-green foliage and delicate, quivering inflorescence. Quaking Grass has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Quaking Grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
